description: Codon-usage-weighted synonymous-shuffle null (vectorised, 20,000 permutations per species) for the TMEM106A exon 6 alternative (+2) frame
code:
import requests, time, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"gsdmd"})
ENS="https://rest.ensembl.org"
def eseq(eid,typ="genomic"):
    for i in range(5):
        try:
            r=S.get(f"{ENS}/sequence/id/{eid}?type={typ}",timeout=60,
                    headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
            if r.status_code==200: return r.json()["seq"]
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(2)
    return None

EX6={"mouse":"ENSMUSE00001226766","human":"ENSE00001627792"}
CAN={"mouse":"ENSMUST00000039581","human":"ENST00000612339"}   # canonical TMEM106A transcripts
seq={k:eseq(v)[:141] for k,v in EX6.items()}
cdsq={k:eseq(v,"cds") for k,v in CAN.items()}
print({k:len(v) for k,v in seq.items()}, {k:len(v) for k,v in cdsq.items()})

bases="TCAG"
aas="FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG"
CODON={a+b+c:aas[i] for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate([(x,y,z) for x in bases for y in bases for z in bases])}
def tr_(s): return "".join(CODON.get(s[i:i+3].upper(),"X") for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3))
SYN={}
for c,a in CODON.items(): SYN.setdefault(a,[]).append(c)

rng=np.random.default_rng(20261125); N=20000
res={}
for sp in ["mouse","human"]:
    s=seq[sp].upper(); codons=[s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,141,3)]
    alt=tr_(s[2:]); L=alt.find("*"); real=len(alt) if L<0 else L

    cnt=Counter(cdsq[sp][i:i+3].upper() for i in range(0,len(cdsq[sp])-2,3))
    W={}
    for aa,cods in SYN.items():
        a=np.array([cnt.get(x,0)+1 for x in cods],dtype=float); W[aa]=a/a.sum()

    # vectorised: sample N synonyms independently at each of the 47 codon positions
    cols=[]
    for c in codons:
        aa=CODON[c]; cods=np.array(SYN[aa])
        cols.append(cods[rng.choice(len(cods),size=N,p=W[aa])])
    mat=np.array(cols)                      # (47, N)
    perms=["".join(mat[:,j]) for j in range(N)]
    null=np.empty(N,dtype=int)
    for j,p_ in enumerate(perms):
        a=tr_(p_[2:]); l=a.find("*"); null[j]= len(a) if l<0 else l
    pv=(np.sum(null>=real)+1)/(N+1)
    res[sp]=(real,null,pv)
    print(f"{sp}: observed {real} codons | null median {np.median(null):.0f} | mean {null.mean():.1f} "
          f"| 95th pct {np.percentile(null,95):.0f} | p = {pv:.4f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
for ax,sp in zip(axes,["mouse","human"]):
    real,null,pv=res[sp]
    ax.hist(null,bins=range(0,52),color="#6e8fb2",edgecolor="white")
    ax.axvline(real,color="#c0392b",lw=2)
    ax.text(real-1,ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.88,f"observed {real}",color="#c0392b",ha="right",fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(f"{sp} TMEM106A exon 6, codon usage weighted null\np = {pv:.3f}",fontsize=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("alternative (+2) frame ORF length, codons"); ax.set_ylabel("permutations")
plt.suptitle("Sensitivity analysis: synonyms weighted by native TMEM106A codon usage (20,000 permutations)",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
